source_text: Absolutist claims equating male circumcision to mutilation overlook data showing complication rates below 0.5% in hospital settings versus higher non-medical ritual risks, and fail to account for evolutionary and physiological roles of the foreskin that, while sensitive, do not preclude overall utility in disease prevention.
